title: Recognizing suicide as a serious public health problem and expressing support for the designation of September as "National Suicide Prevention Month" as well as September 10, 2025, as "World Suicide Prevention Day".
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.
summary: This resolution expresses support for the designation of National Suicide Prevention Month and World Suicide Prevention Day.
